purpose: Audit only selected source-view preprocessing and global embedding cache consistency on the sealed Fresh B cohort. Do not load or inspect generated prediction PNGs, GT color metrics, or repair outputs.
object_seed_rule: 42 + zero-based line index from the frozen Fresh B list
source_view_selection: Reproduce the dataset's alpha-zero-count comparison between views 000 and 014. Only the selected source RGB is encoded; no other target RGB is read.
embedding_comparison: Recompute both frozen vision encoders from the exact seeded cond_imgs produced by load_im_cond, then compare against embeddings/global_embeds.npy after casting to the cache dtype.
forbidden_during_audit: using audit results to change repair parameters
